name: @trajectonomics/data
description: The data site at trajectonomics.com/data/: static Astro pages with Svelte islands, an hourly usage ingest into D1, and cached daily rollups. Never published to npm.

scripts.typecheck: astro sync && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc -p tsconfig.json && astro check && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --fail-on-warnings
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
